verdict.rationale: Whether a spend-management SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Brex releasing any product source code or an open-source license. The public APIs, MCP server, llms.txt and integrations are developer interfaces, not open-source code, and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
